lines.en: Past this stone pillar lies my hive.
The sculk veins show me the way.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍慢些，省力去传播。
lines.en: Beat slower and save strength to spread.
Infection rides on my wings.

lines.zh: 我尾针里的东西，会传染。
lines.en: What is in my stinger spreads.

lines.zh: 那棵树在动，是感染在爬。
lines.en: That tree moves; the infection climbs.

lines.zh: 下面那片空地，适合筑巢。
lines.en: That clearing below is good for a hive.
The sculk hive lies right below.

lines.zh: 这股上升气流带着孢子味。
lines.en: This updraft carries the smell of spores.

lines.zh: 我飞过的地方，草都变蓝了。
lines.en: Where I fly, the grass turns blue.
I smell the moisture in the soil.

lines.zh: 今天翅膀拍得比昨天稳。
lines.en: My wings beat steadier today than yesterday.
Fly higher; only then does infection spread.

lines.zh: 我身上这层粉，专往活物上撒。
lines.en: The dust on me is meant for the living.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上爬得比我快。
lines.en: My shadow climbs the wall faster than I fly.
I fly low along the sculk veins.

lines.zh: 花开过的地方，如今铺满菌毯。
lines.en: Where flowers once bloomed, the sculk mat now spreads.
The sculk mat on the altar is the softest.
I fold my wings and hang on a sculk vine.

lines.zh: 下面有脚步，不是同伴的。
lines.en: Footsteps below—not one of my hive.
The distant thunder sounds like a heartbeat.
Is it time to return and feed the larvae?

lines.zh: 太阳太晃眼，我贴着阴影。
lines.en: The sun is glaring, I hug the shade.
A quick nap; I will wake right up.

lines.zh: 我飞过的地方，苔变深绿。
lines.en: Where I fly, the moss turns deep green.

lines.zh: 幽匿把我的念头吃掉了。
lines.en: Sculk ate my train of thought.

lines.zh: 我翅尖上沾的，会传给你。
lines.en: What clings to my wings will pass to you.

lines.zh: 这个高度，孢子正好散开。
lines.en: At this height the spores scatter just right.

lines.zh: 你的影子沾上了我的孢子。
lines.en: Your shadow has caught my spores.
There is sculk on my stinger.
The name's Sculk Bee Infector, remember.

lines.zh: 你抬头，是在找我的影子？
lines.en: You look up—searching for my shadow?
Stay away from my sculk hive.
This sting of mine is infection.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我的孢子会落下来。
lines.en: Don't blink; my spores are drifting down.
My mycelium will like that hide of yours.
I drop lower, aiming for the top of your head.

lines.zh: 铁甲和汗味，从你身上冒出来。
lines.en: Iron armor and sweat rise off you.
My wing membrane has been torn open!
My wing membrane tore, and spores leak out.
I pull back, my wings still trembling.

lines.zh: 下手这么重，孢子都洒了。
lines.en: You hit so hard my spores spilled.
Wing membrane torn, I fly crooked.
My wing membrane's torn and I fly crooked.
That hurt—who swatted me?

lines.zh: 我飞不稳了，翅膀在掉渣。
lines.en: I cannot fly steady; my wings are shedding.
You hit me, and my wing hangs crooked.
An infector fears being swatted.

lines.zh: 我不抢，只把孢子撒过去。
lines.en: I don't snatch; I just scatter spores your way.
Drop a bit of rotten meat—just a little.

lines.zh: 你指缝里的腐渣，分我一点。
lines.en: Share the rot caught between your fingers.

lines.zh: 我是传播者，毒液就是种子。
lines.en: I'm the infector — my venom is the seed.
I smell the sweetness of rotting leaves.
The sting on my tail carries mycelium.

lines.zh: 让我尝一口，我保证不蜇。
lines.en: Let me taste it; I promise not to sting.
This smells like flowers, but is not.
Don't put it away; let me smell it again.

lines.zh: 我飞一圈，这片地就染了色。
lines.en: One lap of mine stains the ground.

lines.zh: 你这一撞，孢子全糊我脸上。
lines.en: That bump smeared my own spores across my face.
One sting from me plants the mycelium.
Next time I'll hum before I fly.

lines.zh: 传粉的口器，早换了用途。
lines.en: My pollinator mouthparts serve a new purpose.
Stop butting the base of my wing.

lines.zh: 你走路怎么不看我的方向？
lines.en: Why don't you look my way when you walk?
Sorry, I didn't see your shoulder.
Who moved this path?

lines.zh: 我差点撞上谁放的菌块。
lines.en: I nearly hit a fungal block someone left.
This wall is actually breathing.

lines.zh: 这个高度，只有我们两只。
lines.en: At this height, there's only the two of us.
We circle this fungal pillar together.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开，你看见孢子了吗？
lines.en: Wings open—do you see the spores?

lines.zh: 我的巢筑在最高那根枝上。
lines.en: My hive sits on the highest branch.
Sculk spores, circle with me.
My buzzing spreads the fungus.

lines.zh: 最粗的那根枝，留给我们。
lines.en: I've saved the thickest branch for us.

lines.zh: 我给你抓了只沾菌的虫。
lines.en: I caught you an insect dusted with sculk.
You'll do—your wing color is just right.

lines.zh: 我在这棵枯树上守了三夜。
lines.en: I have guarded this dead tree for three nights.
One touch from me and you change.
I hide this piece in a tree hollow.

lines.zh: 这块腐肉，能养一窝幼虫。
lines.en: This rotten meat can feed a whole brood.

lines.zh: 掉了也别怪我，我翅不稳。
lines.en: Don't blame me if it drops; my wings are unsteady.
Perfect for lining the nest.
Spores hide under my wings.
What I found has a strange shape.

lines.zh: 差点连爪子一起掉下去。
lines.en: I nearly dropped with it, claws and all.

lines.zh: 扎一下，你就开始同化了。
lines.en: One sting and the assimilation begins.
This weight — I can still fly.

lines.zh: 别动，菌丝已经爬上你鞋。
lines.en: Hold still; my mycelium is on your boots.
I mean to have this mouthful of flesh.

lines.zh: 今天这只猎物，够整巢吃。
lines.en: Today's catch will feed the whole hive.

lines.zh: 你在下面走，我在上面数。
lines.en: You walk below; I count you from above.

lines.zh: 你的体温，被菌丝闻到了。
lines.en: My mycelium has smelled your body heat.
One buzz, and the infection begins.

lines.zh: 我从上面把孢子撒下去。
lines.en: I sprinkle spores from above.
I'll hum once, then dive.
Wings folded. Now the claws.
I've locked on; don't move.
You hide in the shadows—just as I hoped.

lines.zh: 幽匿丝已经缠到你脚边。
lines.en: Sculk threads are already at your feet.
I'm faster than you—and so are my spores.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，贴着你的肩。
lines.en: I drop low, skimming your shoulder.
I can keep flying all day.

lines.zh: 风把你的气味送到我翅下。
lines.en: The wind carries your scent beneath my wings.

lines.zh: 你一回头，孢子就落进领口。
lines.en: When you turn, spores fall into your collar.
I'm right above you—don't look up.

lines.zh: 快点跑，我的孢子等不及。
lines.en: Run faster; my spores won't wait.
One sting and the sculk starts growing.

lines.zh: 我贴着树皮飞，孢子先到。
lines.en: I skim the bark; my spores arrive first.

lines.zh: 再跑十步，你就进孢子区。
lines.en: Ten more steps and you enter the spore field.

lines.zh: 你听见的嗡声，是我在靠近。
lines.en: That hum you hear is me closing in.
Sculk has paved this whole path.
Don't breathe the spores on my wingtips.

lines.zh: 让开，不然连你一起感染。
lines.en: Move aside, or I'll infect you too.
An infected bee stings differently.
This sting carries the infection.

lines.zh: 我翅尖的孢子，别吸进去。
lines.en: Don't breathe in the spores on my wingtips.
I only go for the living.

lines.zh: 别挣扎，省点力气给菌丝。
lines.en: Stop struggling; save your strength for the mycelium.
My sting carries mycelium.
That one went in too shallow.
This sting delivers the spores.
Fresh from the cocoon, my wings still wet.

lines.zh: 空气好冷，我的翅都僵了。
lines.en: The air is cold; my wings have gone stiff.
I hear the hive calling me.

lines.zh: 幽匿孢子把我送到这儿。
lines.en: Sculk spores set me down here.
This patch of sky belongs to my hive now.
I have woken from beneath the sculk mat.
Two wingbeats first, to shake loose the spores.

lines.zh: 空气里飘来活物的体温。
lines.en: A living creature's warmth drifts through the air.
It's not dawn yet—perfect for infecting.

lines.zh: 我从幽匿块里钻出来，翅膀带粉。
lines.en: I crawl from the sculk block, wings dusted.

lines.zh: 火舌舔过，我的翅膀冒烟。
lines.en: A tongue of fire licked past; my wing smokes.
The ground is close and I can't pull up.
Water floods my wing base—pull me up.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的孢子全吹散。
lines.en: The blast blew all my spores away.
Arrow hit — who shot it?
Magic runs through my wing veins and numbs them.

lines.zh: 饿得拍不动翅，孢子也稀。
lines.en: Too hungry to beat my wings; my spores are thin.

lines.zh: 雷火烧焦了我半片翅膀。
lines.en: Lightning scorched half of my wing.
In the void, I cannot feel my wings.
